line: It's a long way to the other side of this. That film's been there since the last cycle. You could wipe it... I've already logged the wipe. Saves us both time.
Long crossing, and no one else in it. Sella Rusk once worked on my forward viewport, using a hand buffer, and I thought a seal was going to give.
Plenty of time before anything happens. The seal's stuck. You're close. Just need to pull it.
Hours of this left, Captain. Bexley had her hands in my coupling housings, slow pressure flush, and I thought something was going to pop loose.
Nothing out here for hours yet. Mrs. Kross had her hands on me for hours. Warm solvent, slow work. I almost lost pressure entirely.
Long way still to run. My secondary manifold wants flushing. You're going to have to do it yourself.
This is a very long flight. Doctor Hesse used a fine magnetic pick on my manifold. Took forever to get that seal back in place.
We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. This cable's got a kink in it. I don't like it there. You'd know what to do about that.
Long crossing, and no one else in it. My hydraulics are loose. You could tighten them. I'd like you to.
This is a very long flight. The Dalley girl had her hands on me for three hours. Nano vibration gun, slow and careful. I almost vented, but she didn't let me.
Long way still to run. Ferro had his hands on me once. He used a heated seal iron, and I almost lost pressure entirely.
It's a long way to the other side of this. My intake's got a dusting due. You're the one who's got the tools.
Nothing out here for hours yet. Young Tam once worked on my access ports, using a soft bristle rotary. I thought something was going to pop loose.
Plenty of time before anything happens. Hydraulics are loose in my knees. You could take a look if you want. My landing gear, technically.
We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. Port coupling's loose. You might want to tighten it before it slips.
Hours of this left, Captain. Mister Ovin worked me over with that ultrasonic probe — didn't think I'd ever been that loose before.
